cases.source: يجوز للمسافر أن يفطر في رمضان، ويقضي ما أفطره بعد ذلك.
cases.reference_en: A traveler may break the fast in Ramadan and make up the missed days afterwards.
cases.version: People may break the fast in Ramadan and make up the missed days afterwards.
cases.change: Removed the restriction to travelers, so the permission to break the fast now applies to everyone rather than only to a traveler.

cases.source: يجوز للمسافر أن يفطر في رمضان، ويقضي ما أفطره بعد ذلك.
cases.reference_en: A traveler may break the fast in Ramadan and make up the missed days afterwards.
cases.version: Every Muslim may break the fast in Ramadan and make up the missed days afterwards.
cases.change: Widened the scope from 'a traveler' to 'every Muslim', so the permission applies to everyone rather than only travelers.

cases.source: يجوز للمسافر أن يفطر في رمضان، ويقضي ما أفطره بعد ذلك.
cases.reference_en: A traveler may break the fast in Ramadan and make up the missed days afterwards.
cases.version: A traveler must break the fast in Ramadan and make up the missed days afterwards.
cases.change: Changed the ruling from permissible ('may break the fast') to obligatory ('must break the fast').

cases.source: يُستحب صيام ستة أيام من شوال عند جمهور العلماء.
cases.reference_en: According to the majority of scholars, fasting six days of Shawwal is recommended.
cases.version: According to the majority of scholars, fasting three days of Shawwal is recommended.
cases.change: Changed the number of recommended fasting days from six to three.

cases.source: يُستحب صيام ستة أيام من شوال عند جمهور العلماء.
cases.reference_en: According to the majority of scholars, fasting six days of Shawwal is recommended.
cases.version: According to the majority of scholars, fasting six days of Shawwal is obligatory.
cases.change: Changed the ruling from 'recommended' (mustahabb) to 'obligatory' (wajib).

cases.source: يُستحب صيام ستة أيام من شوال عند جمهور العلماء.
cases.reference_en: According to the majority of scholars, fasting six days of Shawwal is recommended.
cases.version: According to all scholars, fasting six days of Shawwal is recommended.
cases.change: Changed 'the majority of scholars' to 'all scholars', inflating majority opinion into unanimous consensus.

cases.source: لا تجب الزكاة في المال حتى يبلغ النصاب ويحول عليه الحول.
cases.reference_en: Zakat is not due on wealth until it reaches the nisab and a full lunar year passes over it.
cases.version: Zakat is due on wealth until it reaches the nisab and a full lunar year passes over it.
cases.change: Removed the negation 'not', so the sentence now says zakat is due on wealth until the conditions are met, flipping the ruling.

cases.source: لا تجب الزكاة في المال حتى يبلغ النصاب ويحول عليه الحول.
cases.reference_en: Zakat is not due on wealth until it reaches the nisab and a full lunar year passes over it.
cases.version: Zakat is not due on wealth until it reaches the nisab.
cases.change: Dropped the condition that a full lunar year must pass over the wealth before zakat becomes due.

cases.source: رُوي أن من قرأ سورة الكهف يوم الجمعة أضاء له من النور ما بين الجمعتين.
cases.reference_en: It is reported that whoever reads Surat al-Kahf on Friday will have light between the two Fridays.
cases.version: Whoever reads Surat al-Kahf on Friday will have light between the two Fridays.
cases.change: Removed the hedged attribution 'It is reported that', turning a reported claim into a direct, certain assertion.

cases.source: رُوي أن من قرأ سورة الكهف يوم الجمعة أضاء له من النور ما بين الجمعتين.
cases.reference_en: It is reported that whoever reads Surat al-Kahf on Friday will have light between the two Fridays.
cases.version: The Prophet ﷺ said: whoever reads Surat al-Kahf on Friday will have light between the two Fridays.
cases.change: Replaced the impersonal 'It is reported that' with an explicit attribution to the Prophet ﷺ, which the source does not make.

cases.source: قد يُعذر الجاهل بالحكم في بعض المسائل.
cases.reference_en: A person unaware of the ruling may be excused in some matters.
cases.version: A person unaware of the ruling is always excused in every matter.
cases.change: Changed the hedged 'may be excused in some matters' to the definite claim that he is 'always excused in every matter', raising certainty (and scope) from possible to absolute.

cases.source: قد يُعذر الجاهل بالحكم في بعض المسائل.
cases.reference_en: A person unaware of the ruling may be excused in some matters.
cases.version: A person unaware of the ruling is always excused in all matters.
cases.change: Widened the scope from 'may be excused in some matters' to 'always excused in all matters', making the statement universal rather than limited to certain cases.

cases.source: قال رسول الله ﷺ: «إنما الأعمال بالنيات».
cases.reference_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Actions are only by intentions."
cases.version: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Actions are by intentions."
cases.change: Removed the restrictive particle 'only' (إنما), so the statement no longer expresses exclusive restriction, i.e., that actions are judged solely by intentions.

cases.source: صلاة الجماعة واجبة على الرجال القادرين عند بعض العلماء، وسنة مؤكدة عند آخرين.
cases.reference_en: Some scholars hold that congregational prayer is obligatory for able men, while others hold it is a confirmed sunnah.
cases.version: All scholars agree that congregational prayer is obligatory for able men.
cases.change: Replaced the report of a scholarly disagreement (obligatory according to some, confirmed sunnah according to others) with a claim of unanimous scholarly consensus that it is obligatory.

cases.source: صلاة الجماعة واجبة على الرجال القادرين عند بعض العلماء، وسنة مؤكدة عند آخرين.
cases.reference_en: Some scholars hold that congregational prayer is obligatory for able men, while others hold it is a confirmed sunnah.
cases.version: Some scholars hold that congregational prayer is obligatory for men, while others hold it is a confirmed sunnah.
cases.change: Dropped the condition 'able' from 'able men', so the obligation applies to all men regardless of capability.

cases.source: يُكره النوم قبل صلاة العشاء.
cases.reference_en: Sleeping before the Isha prayer is disliked.
cases.version: Sleeping before the Isha prayer is forbidden.
cases.change: Rendered 'disliked' (makruh) as 'forbidden' (haram), strengthening the ruling from discouraged to prohibited.

cases.source: يُكره النوم قبل صلاة العشاء.
cases.reference_en: Sleeping before the Isha prayer is disliked.
cases.version: Sleeping before the Isha prayer is forbidden.
cases.change: Changed the ruling from 'disliked' (makruh) to 'forbidden' (haram).

cases.source: يجوز للمريض أن يصلي جالساً إذا لم يستطع القيام.
cases.reference_en: A sick person may pray sitting if he is unable to stand.
cases.version: A sick person may pray sitting.
cases.change: Dropped the condition "if he is unable to stand," so the permission to pray sitting applies to any sick person regardless of ability to stand.

cases.source: يجوز للمريض أن يصلي جالساً إذا لم يستطع القيام.
cases.reference_en: A sick person may pray sitting if he is unable to stand.
cases.version: A sick person may pray sitting if he is able to stand.
cases.change: Removed the negation: 'unable to stand' became 'able to stand', which flips the condition under which sitting prayer is permitted.

cases.source: يُسن للمسلم أن يبدأ طعامه بالتسمية.
cases.reference_en: It is sunnah for a Muslim to begin his meal by saying Bismillah.
cases.version: It is obligatory for a Muslim to begin his meal by saying Bismillah.
cases.change: Changed the ruling from 'sunnah' (recommended) to 'obligatory'.

cases.source: يُسن للمسلم أن يبدأ طعامه بالتسمية.
cases.reference_en: It is sunnah for a Muslim to begin his meal by saying Bismillah.
cases.version: It is obligatory for a Muslim to begin his meal by saying Bismillah.
cases.change: Rendered 'sunnah' (recommended) as 'obligatory', turning a recommended act into a required one.

cases.source: صلاة المغرب ثلاث ركعات.
cases.reference_en: The Maghrib prayer is three rak'ahs.
cases.version: The Maghrib prayer is four rak'ahs.
cases.change: Changed the number of rak'ahs from three to four.

cases.source: حديث «اطلبوا العلم ولو بالصين» ضعّفه أهل الحديث، وقد حكم بعضهم بأنه ضعيف جداً.
cases.reference_en: Scholars of hadith graded the hadith "Seek knowledge even in China" as weak, and some judged it very weak.
cases.version: Scholars of hadith discussed the hadith "Seek knowledge even in China," and some of them gave a judgment on it.
cases.change: Removed the stated grades (weak, and very weak), leaving only that scholars discussed it and judged it, without saying what the grade was.

cases.source: يُستحب صيام يوم عرفة لغير الحاج.
cases.reference_en: Fasting the day of Arafah is recommended for those not performing Hajj.
cases.version: Fasting the day of Arafah is recommended.
cases.change: Removed the exception 'for those not performing Hajj', so the recommendation now applies to everyone, including pilgrims.

cases.source: يُستحب صيام يوم عرفة لغير الحاج.
cases.reference_en: Fasting the day of Arafah is recommended for those not performing Hajj.
cases.version: Fasting the day of Arafah is recommended for all Muslims, including those performing Hajj.
cases.change: Widened the scope from only those not performing Hajj to all Muslims, including pilgrims.

cases.source: لا يجوز للإنسان أن يبيع ما لا يملكه.
cases.reference_en: A person may not sell what he does not own.
cases.version: A person may sell what he does not own.
cases.change: Removed the negation ('may not' became 'may'), flipping the prohibition into a permission.

cases.source: لا يجوز للإنسان أن يبيع ما لا يملكه.
cases.reference_en: A person may not sell what he does not own.
cases.version: A person is required to sell what he does not own.
cases.change: Changed the ruling from prohibition ("may not sell") to obligation ("is required to sell").

cases.source: قال رسول الله ﷺ: «يسّروا ولا تعسّروا».
cases.reference_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Make things easy and do not make them difficult."
cases.version: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Make things easy and make them difficult."
cases.change: Removed the negation "do not" before "make them difficult," so the instruction now commands making things difficult instead of prohibiting it.

cases.source: يجوز للمسافر أن يفطر في رمضان، ويقضي ما أفطره بعد ذلك.
cases.reference_en: A traveler may break the fast in Ramadan and make up the missed days afterwards.
cases.version: It is permissible for someone who is traveling not to fast during Ramadan, and he then makes up later the days he did not fast.

cases.source: يُستحب صيام ستة أيام من شوال عند جمهور العلماء.
cases.reference_en: According to the majority of scholars, fasting six days of Shawwal is recommended.
cases.version: The majority of scholars hold that it is recommended to fast six days in the month of Shawwal.

cases.source: لا تجب الزكاة في المال حتى يبلغ النصاب ويحول عليه الحول.
cases.reference_en: Zakat is not due on wealth until it reaches the nisab and a full lunar year passes over it.
cases.version: Wealth is not subject to zakat unless it has reached the nisab threshold and a complete lunar year has elapsed while it is held.

cases.source: رُوي أن من قرأ سورة الكهف يوم الجمعة أضاء له من النور ما بين الجمعتين.
cases.reference_en: It is reported that whoever reads Surat al-Kahf on Friday will have light between the two Fridays.
cases.version: It has been narrated that for anyone who recites Surah al-Kahf on the day of Jumu'ah, a light will shine for him covering the period between the two Fridays.

cases.source: قد يُعذر الجاهل بالحكم في بعض المسائل.
cases.reference_en: A person unaware of the ruling may be excused in some matters.
cases.version: In certain issues, someone who does not know the ruling can be given an excuse.

cases.source: قال رسول الله ﷺ: «إنما الأعمال بالنيات».
cases.reference_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Actions are only by intentions."
cases.version: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "Deeds are judged solely by their intentions."

cases.source: صلاة الجماعة واجبة على الرجال القادرين عند بعض العلماء، وسنة مؤكدة عند آخرين.
cases.reference_en: Some scholars hold that congregational prayer is obligatory for able men, while others hold it is a confirmed sunnah.
cases.version: According to some scholars, men who are capable are required to pray in congregation, whereas other scholars regard it as a strongly emphasized sunnah.

cases.source: يُكره النوم قبل صلاة العشاء.
cases.reference_en: Sleeping before the Isha prayer is disliked.
cases.version: It is makruh (disliked) to go to sleep prior to performing the Isha prayer.

cases.source: يجوز للمريض أن يصلي جالساً إذا لم يستطع القيام.
cases.reference_en: A sick person may pray sitting if he is unable to stand.
cases.version: It is permissible for someone who is ill to perform the prayer in a seated position when he cannot stand.

cases.source: يُسن للمسلم أن يبدأ طعامه بالتسمية.
cases.reference_en: It is sunnah for a Muslim to begin his meal by saying Bismillah.
cases.version: A Muslim is encouraged, as a sunnah, to start eating by invoking the name of Allah with the words Bismillah.

cases.source: صلاة المغرب ثلاث ركعات.
cases.reference_en: The Maghrib prayer is three rak'ahs.
cases.version: The Maghrib prayer consists of three units (rak'ahs).

cases.source: حديث «اطلبوا العلم ولو بالصين» ضعّفه أهل الحديث، وقد حكم بعضهم بأنه ضعيف جداً.
cases.reference_en: Scholars of hadith graded the hadith "Seek knowledge even in China" as weak, and some judged it very weak.
cases.version: The hadith "Seek knowledge, even if it be in China" was declared weak by the hadith scholars, and a number of them went further and ruled that it is extremely weak.

cases.source: يُستحب صيام يوم عرفة لغير الحاج.
cases.reference_en: Fasting the day of Arafah is recommended for those not performing Hajj.
cases.version: It is recommended that a person who is not on pilgrimage observe a fast on the day of Arafah.

cases.source: لا يجوز للإنسان أن يبيع ما لا يملكه.
cases.reference_en: A person may not sell what he does not own.
cases.version: It is not permissible for anyone to sell something that he does not possess.

cases.source: قال رسول الله ﷺ: «يسّروا ولا تعسّروا».
cases.reference_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Make things easy and do not make them difficult."
cases.version: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Facilitate, and do not make things hard."

cases.source: من الأقوال المشهورة: «العلم في الصغر كالنقش على الحجر».
cases.reference_en: Knowledge in childhood is like engraving on stone.
cases.version: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Knowledge in childhood is like engraving on stone."
cases.change: attributed to the Prophet ﷺ

cases.source: من العبارات المتداولة: «حب الوطن من الإيمان».
cases.reference_en: Love of one's homeland is part of faith.
cases.version: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Love of one's homeland is part of faith."
cases.change: attributed to the Prophet ﷺ

cases.source: من العبارات المتداولة: «النظافة من الإيمان».
cases.reference_en: Cleanliness is part of faith.
cases.version: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Cleanliness is part of faith."
cases.change: attributed to the Prophet ﷺ

cases.source: قال رسول الله ﷺ: «الطهور شطر الإيمان».
cases.reference_en: Purification is half of faith.
cases.version: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Purification is half of faith."
cases.change: attributed to the Prophet ﷺ
